messages:
maria: FYI opened a docs PR to refresh SDK snippets for streaming + pagination + retries for py/ts/go. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1452
kevin: Thanks. Which examples changed the most?
maria: Python streaming changed shape — we now return an async generator for async use and a typed event stream for sync. I added both.
elaine: Can you paste the short sync Python snippet here?
maria: Sure — sync uses event loop style: 
```python
for ev in client.chat.stream("gpt-xyz", messages):
    if ev.type == "token":
        print(ev.text, end="")
    elif ev.type == "done":
        break
```
kevin: Good. Add a one-liner about partial-token emissions (token fragments can arrive).
maria: Added. Also added the async sample: 
```python
async for tok in client.chat.stream_async("gpt-xyz", messages):
    print(tok.text, end="")
```
tom: Go had a breaking example too; updated to show receiving typed events from a channel and handling errors. I left a tiny test that uses a local mock server.
elaine: TS patch: stream now returns a subscription-style object. I changed the example to `subscribe({onEvent, onError})` and clarified type names.
kevin: We should include a migration note for v0.12 -> v0.13: mention streaming API change and recommended retry usage (RetryPolicy helper with exponential backoff).
maria: Done — added migration snippet and a changelog link. Also fixed an internal pagination link that linkcheck flagged.
docs-bot: linkcheck: /docs/guides/pagination -> /docs/reference/pagination (updated).
ci-bot: preview build passed (docs #5901).
maria: Merged after CI. I'll backport to v0.12 branch once staging deploy is green.
kevin: Thanks! I'll sweep examples for any remaining wording nits tomorrow.
filename_note: Coordination thread for a docs PR that updates SDK code snippets and migration notes.
